notes.text: Available in cPanel 11 and later. Omitted request options retain server defaults; explicit false and zero remain explicit.

Only root and root-enabled resellers may authorize root public keys. file must exist under /root/.ssh; text takes precedence when both are supplied. Preserve both formally required arguments. options is a comma-separated string, omitted for no options. Key text is sensitive. Authorization changes access immediately; the client does not retry or roll back.
